metadata.purpose: Host scope text and footer; shared row metadata is owned by packages/article-list.

extensions.tonalRampPurpose: Derived display previews only; these OKLCH ramps are not source CSS tokens. Actual light/dark values remain in DESIGN.md frontmatter.
extensions.rasterProvenance: No raster images are bundled for this surface. Embed metadata supplies remote article thumbnails; review screenshots are evidence only.

sharedArticleList.ownership: Canonical module owns row structure, row typography, keyed updates, and preview behavior. Host owns theme aliases, visible columns, and responsive row sizing. No normative row tokens or copied row snippets in this sidecar.

components.name: Refresh button
components.description: Feed refresh action with hover, focus, and loading state.
components.css: .ds-refresh {font: 16px/1.55 system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dce0e7); border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 12px;background: var(--accent, #a92857); color: #fff; border-color: var(--accent, #a92857); cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-refresh:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-refresh:disabled { opacity: .65; cursor: wait; } .ds-refresh:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #a92857); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-refresh { background: var(--accent, #f19cba); border-color: var(--accent, #f19cba); color: #252936; } .ds-refresh:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--accent, #f19cba); } }

components.name: Title search
components.html: <label class="ds-search-label">제목 검색<input class="ds-search" type="search" placeholder="찾고 싶은 글 제목"></label>
components.css: .ds-search-label { display: grid; gap: 6px; font: 600 14px/1.55 system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text, #252936); } .ds-search {font: 600 14px/1.55 system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dce0e7); border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 12px;width: 100%; min-width: 0; box-sizing: border-box; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--text, #252936); caret-color: var(--accent, #a92857); }.ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #a92857); outline-offset: 3px; }.ds-search::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #596174); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-search-label, .ds-search { color: var(--text, #eceef3); } .ds-search { background: var(--surface, #282d38); border-color: var(--line, #444b5e); caret-color: var(--accent, #f19cba); } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--accent, #f19cba); } .ds-search::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #b4bbcd); } }

narrative.overview:
The incumbent interface uses the system font, simple controls, and a title-led list. Visual emphasis supports reading and operating the extension. The follow-feed surface adds a restrained pink accent and system theme response to this existing vocabulary.

This document records the host styling in `arca-liked.css`, the follow-feed behavior in `arca-liked.html` and `arca-liked.js`, and related settings patterns in `options.html`. Row structure, title styling, reconciliation, and thumbnail interaction belong to the shared [article-list module](../../packages/article-list/index.js) and its [canonical stylesheet](../../packages/article-list/article-list.css), also used by KarmoAI. Extension `vendor/article-list.*` files are generated copies. Host palette, columns, and control sizing stay local; settings retain native controls and the blue selected-tab indicator. Row tokens and preview snippets are intentionally not duplicated here.
keyCharacteristics: System typography and explicit text labels.
Flat neutral surfaces with row separators.
Pink feed actions and writer links; blue settings selection.
Compact one-line rows with accessible thumbnail previews and visible progress and failure context.
dos: Do preserve system typography, native controls, and the current distinction between feed and settings styling.
Do keep post titles primary and author, channel, and date secondary.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, one-line title/author rows, thumbnail dismissal, and the implemented system-theme response.
Do express loading, empty results, and author failures with specific text and the current simple containers.
donts: Don't apply the feed's pink palette to all settings or treat its mobile breakpoint as a global extension rule.
Don't turn list rows into elevated cards or introduce ornamental imagery, custom fonts, or motion absent from the source.
Don't fork canonical row markup, row typography, or preview behavior into extension-local implementations.
Don't imply that color alone communicates loading, selection, or failure.
